## What’s fixed
- Ordered lists now keep the same font, wrapping, and line spacing across every item on older macOS versions. - CueNow no longer lets the system’s automatic text replacement compete with its numbered-list editor, preventing malformed `1.Text` formatting. - Glass notes on macOS 15 and earlier now use a translucent, appearance-adaptive background in both Light and Dark Mode. - Shared diagnostic logs now include the macOS version, appearance, transparency setting, and note style to make display-specific reports actionable.

## What’s fixed
- Glass notes on macOS 15 and earlier now use the system’s appearance-adaptive blur, so Light Mode no longer receives a forced dark overlay. - Checkbox selections now treat the checkbox marker and its spacer as one control. Deleting a partial keyboard or mouse selection can no longer leave the checkbox misaligned.

## What’s fixed
- The menu bar now keeps showing **Update available** after you choose **Later** in the update dialog. - Manual and automatic update checks now share the same update state, so the available-version badge remains accurate until the update is installed or is no longer newer.
This release keeps the existing adaptive blue version badge styling in both Light and Dark Mode.
